correctness.rationale: For C_n under symmetric unit valuation of neighbors and zero self-value, each grand-coalition member has utility 2/n. A strict-blocking S of size s needs n d_{C_n[S]}(i)>2s for every included i. A nonempty proper cycle subset cannot have all induced degrees 2; hence strict blockers are exactly s<n/2 with no isolated selected vertices. Decompose cyclic binary words into r one-runs of lengths≥2 and r zero-runs lengths≥1, yielding n/r*binom(s−r−1,r−1)*binom(n−s−1,r−1). At z0=3/4, 3-state transfer matrix has simple dominant root 3/2, logarithmic coefficient mean1/2, variance1/3. Distinct-phase self-loops enforce spectral aperiodicity and Fourier local CLT; dominated geometric summation below n/2 proves parity constants 3√3 (even), 6 (odd) times (√3/2)^n/sqrt(2πn). Independently enumerated all selected coalitions n=3..15 and compared direct strict utility with exact run formula, including n=3,4 zero. Finite enumeration is not the local limit proof.
